ValidationRule.description: Do Not Mail can be checked but not unchecked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( PRIORVALUE ( IM_Do_Not_Mail__c ), ISCHANGED ( IM_Do_Not_Mail__c), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_In_Country_Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Marketing", $Profile.Name <> "IMAP_In_Country_Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IMAP_SC_In_Country_Admin+" , $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_In_Country_Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_Custom Sys", $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_In_Country_Admin+", $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_Marketing", $Profile.Name <> "IME_SC_In_Country_Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IMAP_SC_In_Country_Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Marketing", $Profile.Name <> "IM_API Only_Admin" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient privileges to un-check Do Not Mail
